papers.title: Mechanosensitive YAP–RUNX1 signaling drives T H 1 cell dysfunction and tumor immunosuppression
papers.summary: Solid tumor stiffness can limit the ability of immune cells to enter and kill tumor cells. Here the authors show that this stiffness activates YAP signaling in type 1 helper T cells, making them dysfunctional and thereby leading to a more immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment
papers.llm_title_zh: 机械敏感性 YAP–RUNX1 信号传导驱动 T H 1 细胞功能障碍和肿瘤免疫抑制

papers.llm_research_question_zh: 实体瘤硬度会限制免疫细胞进入并杀死肿瘤细胞的能力。
